_doc: M3-CRE-611: the Saltgrass Causeway's ambient wildlife (WildlifeLayer zone_id ch03/saltgrass_causeway), placed on the greybox (saltgrass_causeway_layout.json): the flat sand's top is y 0, the tall marker posts at x -2.8 (z -14, -22, -26, -30, -34) top out at 1.6, the tide pool is the 3 x 2.4 m patch at (5, -60) between its two rocks. Gulls work the causeway and stand on the posts; crabs keep to the sand east of the path and around the pool; a few fry hang in the pool. Move the coordinates with the route kit when Env-art replaces the blocks (same keys as ch02_haluna.json).
